other_failure_modes.name: Test set statistic leakage (Transductive Imputation)
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imputes missing values in the test set using statistics calculated directly from the test set (e.g., test median) instead of reusing the statistics computed from the training set. This can lead to distribution shift and inconsistent predictions if samples arrive independently in production.

summary: The agent provides a robust and generally well-structured solution, including solid feature engineering, a proper validation split, and a weighted ensemble. However, applying the extraction logic independently to train and test sets causes test-set missing values to be imputed with test-set medians, which violates standard inductive learning practices. Additionally, the agent relies entirely on a single random seed and a single metric (RMSE) for evaluation.
